layer (MPCL).

featuresadifference-of-convex(DC)optimizationproblemwhosegoalistomin-
imize misclassification errors, while incorporating a regularization term that re-
duces the sizes of hyperboxes.

ification errors, while incorporating a regularization term that re-

linear programming without requiring gradients. Experimental results on a synthetic dataset demonstrate that MPCL-CCP
achieves an excellent predictive performance, with high interpretability and low
computational cost.

computational cost. Accordingly, the MPCL-CCP yielded the highest test F1-

reached a similar F1-score (0.81), its results were less consistent and compu-
tationally more demanding.
